description: Shared output shape for all cyber-breach participants (Perigon Monitor, LLMs, baselines).

incident.discoveryDate: ISO-8601 date when the incident was first reported
incident.shortDescription: One sentence: what happened and who was affected
incident.attackType: BREACH | RANSOMWARE | DATA_LEAK | PHISHING | MALWARE | DDOS | SUPPLY_CHAIN | INSIDER | OTHER
impactedOrganizationNames: Organization names, including vendors or downstream customers when reported
organizationRoles: direct_victim | vendor | supplier | downstream_customer | other — parallel to names when known

incidents: array of incident objects above, discovered since the lookback window
